recipes.title: Slow-cooker white chicken chili
recipes.blurb: Creamy, mild and cozy, with shredded chicken and white beans

steps.text: Put the chicken in the slow cooker. Season with the cumin, oregano, salt and pepper.
Add the onion, garlic, green chiles and drained beans on top.
Pour in the broth, cover, and cook on low for 6 hours.
Check the chicken is 165°F inside. Lift it out and shred it with two forks.
Stir the chicken back in with the cream cheese. Cover until the cheese melts.
Stir well. Top with cilantro and a squeeze of lime, and serve.

recipes.title: Lemon salmon with green beans
recipes.blurb: Sheet-pan salmon and crisp green beans, ready in 30 minutes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Line a sheet pan with foil.
Toss the green beans with 1 tbsp oil and half the salt and pepper. Spread them on the pan.
Roast the green beans by themselves first.
Push the beans to the sides. Add the salmon, brush with the rest of the oil and garlic, and season.
Sprinkle with dill and lay lemon slices on top. Bake until the salmon is 145°F and flakes easily.
Squeeze the lemon juice over everything and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken noodle soup
recipes.blurb: The classic: tender chicken, carrots and egg noodles

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrots and celery until soft.
Add the garlic and thyme and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the broth, add the whole chicken breasts, and bring to a boil.
Turn the heat to low, cover, and simmer until the chicken is 165°F inside.
Lift out the chicken and shred it with two forks.
Add the noodles to the pot and simmer until tender.
Stir the chicken back in. Taste, add salt and pepper, and serve.

recipes.title: Skillet pork chops with apples
recipes.blurb: Seared chops with cinnamon-brown sugar apples

steps.text: Pat the chops dry. Season both sides with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add the chops and leave them alone to brown.
Flip and cook until a thermometer reads 145°F in the middle.
Move the chops to a plate and cover loosely with foil. They rest while you cook the apples.
Turn the heat to medium. Add the butter, apples, brown sugar and cinnamon. Cook until soft.
Pour in the broth and scrape up the brown bits. Simmer until a little syrupy.
Put the chops back with their juices, spoon the apples over, and serve.

recipes.title: Tomato soup and grilled cheese
recipes.blurb: Creamy homemade tomato soup with golden cheddar sandwiches

steps.text: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion until soft.
Stir in the garlic for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes, broth, sugar and basil.
Bring to a boil, then turn the heat to low and simmer.
Meanwhile, butter one side of each bread slice. Make 4 sandwiches, cheese inside, butter outside.
Cook the sandwiches in a skillet over medium-low until golden, then flip and cook the other side.
Turn off the soup. Blend it smooth with a stick blender, then stir in the cream.
Cut the sandwiches in half and serve with the soup for dipping.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan sausage and vegetables
recipes.blurb: Smoked sausage, potatoes and broccoli on one pan

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a large sheet pan with foil.
Toss the potatoes on the pan with 1 tbsp oil and half the seasonings. Roast them alone first.
Meanwhile, toss the sausage, broccoli, pepper and onion with the rest of the oil and seasonings.
Add them to the pan, stir everything together, and spread it out.
Roast until the potatoes are tender and the sausage is browned and hot.
Serve hot, with mustard for dipping if you like.

recipes.title: Crispy baked chicken tenders
recipes.blurb: Panko-crunchy tenders, no frying, with honey mustard

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Set a wire rack on a sheet pan and coat it with cooking spray.
Mix the panko, Parmesan, garlic powder, paprika and salt in a shallow dish.
Dredge each tender in flour, then egg, then the panko mix. Press the crumbs on.
Set the tenders on the rack and spray the tops well with cooking spray.
Bake until golden and 165°F inside, flipping once halfway.
Serve hot with the honey mustard.

recipes.title: Oven-fried chicken drumsticks
recipes.blurb: Crunchy-skinned drumsticks, baked until juicy

steps.text: Toss the drumsticks in the buttermilk in a big bowl. Let them sit while the oven heats.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a sheet pan with foil and set a rack on top.
Mix the flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper in a bag or dish.
Shake off extra buttermilk, then coat each drumstick in the flour mix.
Place them on the rack and drizzle with the melted butter.
Bake, turning once, until deep golden and 175°F near the bone.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Honey garlic chicken thighs
recipes.blurb: Sticky sweet-savory glaze, one skillet

steps.text: Season the thighs with salt and pepper. Whisk the honey, soy sauce, garlic and vinegar in a bowl.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Brown the thighs.
Flip the thighs and cook the second side until golden.
Pour the sauce over the chicken. Cover and simmer on low until 175°F inside.
Move the chicken to a plate. Stir the cornstarch into the water, then into the pan.
Simmer until the sauce is glossy and thick. Spoon over the chicken.

recipes.title: Oven BBQ chicken drumsticks
recipes.blurb: Sticky barbecue chicken without the grill

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a sheet pan with foil and spray a rack or the foil.
Toss the drumsticks with the oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Bake the drumsticks, turning once.
Brush with half the barbecue sauce. Bake again until sticky.
Turn, brush with the rest of the sauce, and bake until 175°F near the bone.
Rest 5 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Classic roast chicken and potatoes
recipes.blurb: Sunday-style whole bird with crisp skin and golden potatoes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Pat the chicken very dry, inside and out. Remove any giblets.
Rub the butter under and over the skin. Season with salt, pepper and thyme.
Put the lemon and garlic in the cavity. Set the chicken in a roasting pan.
Toss the potatoes and carrots with the oil, salt and pepper. Scatter around the bird.
Roast until a thermometer in the thigh reads 165°F, about 1 hour 15 minutes.
Rest the chicken under foil before carving.
Carve and serve with the vegetables and pan juices.

recipes.title: Honey mustard chicken and broccoli
recipes.blurb: Thighs, potatoes and broccoli roasted on one pan

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on a large sheet pan.
Roast the potatoes by themselves first.
Whisk the mustard, honey, garlic and 1 tbsp oil. Toss the thighs in half of it.
Push the potatoes aside. Add the thighs skin-side up. Roast.
Toss the broccoli with the last 1 tbsp oil. Add to the pan and roast until the chicken is 175°F.
Drizzle the rest of the sauce over the chicken and serve.

recipes.title: Creamy garlic chicken skillet
recipes.blurb: Seared chicken in a quick garlic-Parmesan cream sauce

steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook the chicken until golden and 165°F inside.
Move the chicken to a plate. Add the garlic to the pan and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in the broth and cream. Simmer until slightly thickened.
Stir in the Parmesan and spinach until the spinach wilts.
Return the chicken to the pan, warm through, and serve over pasta or rice.

recipes.title: Air fryer crispy chicken thighs
recipes.blurb: Shatter-crisp skin in under 30 minutes

steps.text: Heat the air fryer to 380°F. Pat the thighs very dry.
Rub the thighs with the oil, then the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper.
Place skin-side down in the basket in one layer. Work in two batches if needed.
Cook skin-side down.
Flip skin-side up and cook until 175°F inside and crisp.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Pan-seared lemon herb chicken breasts
recipes.blurb: Juicy breasts with a fast lemon butter pan sauce

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts (6 oz each)

steps.text: Pound the breasts to an even thickness. Season both sides with salt, pepper and thyme.
Heat the oil and 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook the chicken.
Flip and cook until 165°F inside. Move the chicken to a plate.
Lower the heat. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds. Pour in the broth and lemon juice.
Simmer until reduced by half, then whisk in the last 2 tbsp butter.
Return the chicken, spoon sauce over, and add the lemon slices. Serve.

recipes.title: Classic glazed meatloaf
recipes.blurb: Tender, ketchup-glazed and made for leftover sandwiches

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a sheet pan with foil.
Stir the panko and milk together in a large bowl for 5 minutes.
Add the beef, onion, garlic, eggs, Worcestershire, salt, pepper and 1/4 cup ketchup. Mix gently.
Shape into a loaf about 9 by 5 inches on the pan. Mix the rest of the ketchup with the brown sugar.
Spread the glaze over the loaf. Bake until 160°F in the middle.
Rest 10 minutes, then slice.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker pot roast
recipes.blurb: Fall-apart beef with carrots and potatoes

steps.text: Pat the roast dry and rub it all over with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Sear the roast on all sides until deep brown.
Put the onion, carrots and potatoes in the slow cooker. Set the roast on top.
Whisk the broth, tomato paste and Worcestershire. Pour over and add the thyme.
Cover and cook on low until the roast shreds easily.
Lift out the roast and vegetables. Shred the beef and serve with the juices.

recipes.title: Salisbury steak with mushroom gravy
recipes.blurb: Beef patties in rich onion-mushroom gravy

steps.text: Mix the beef, panko, egg, Worcestershire, salt and pepper. Shape into 4 oval patties.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Brown the patties on both sides.
Move the patties to a plate. Cook the mushrooms and onion in the same pan until soft.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir for 1 minute. Slowly pour in the broth, stirring.
Return the patties to the gravy. Cover and simmer until 160°F inside.
Serve over mashed potatoes or egg noodles.

recipes.title: Garlic butter steak bites
recipes.blurb: Seared sirloin cubes, ready in 20 minutes

steps.text: Pat the steak cubes dry. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat until it shimmers.
Sear the steak in one layer without moving it. Work in two batches.
Turn the pieces and sear until browned. Medium is 135°F.
Lower the heat. Add the butter and garlic and stir for 30 seconds.
Toss the steak in the butter, sprinkle with parsley, and serve.

recipes.title: Oven-baked BBQ ribs
recipes.blurb: Tender, slow-baked ribs with sticky sauce

ingredients.item: racks baby back ribs (about 2 lb each)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 275°F. Peel the thin membrane off the back of each rack.
Mix the brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Rub it all over the ribs.
Wrap each rack tightly in foil and set on a sheet pan.
Bake until the meat is very tender.
Unwrap, brush with sauce, and set the oven to broil. Broil until bubbly and sticky.
Rest 5 minutes, then cut between the bones.

recipes.title: Roasted pork tenderloin and vegetables
recipes.blurb: Garlicky tenderloin with potatoes and carrots

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes and carrots with 2 tbsp oil, half the salt and pepper on a sheet pan.
Roast the vegetables by themselves first.
Rub the pork with 1 tbsp oil, garlic, rosemary and the rest of the salt and pepper.
Push the vegetables aside and set the pork in the middle of the pan.
Roast until the pork is 145°F in the thickest part.
Rest the pork 5 minutes, slice, and serve with the vegetables.

recipes.title: Beef tips and gravy
recipes.blurb: Tender steak tips in onion gravy over egg noodles

steps.text: Season the beef with salt and pepper. Sear in 1 tbsp hot oil in batches until browned. Set aside.
In the same pan add the last 1 tbsp oil, onion and mushrooms. Cook until soft.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute. Slowly add the broth and Worcestershire, stirring.
Return the beef. Cover and simmer on low until the beef is tender.
Boil the noodles in salted water until tender, then drain.
Serve the beef tips and gravy over the noodles.

recipes.title: Brown sugar ham steak with pineapple
recipes.blurb: Sweet and savory, done in 15 minutes

steps.text: Cut the ham steak into 4 pieces. Mix the brown sugar, mustard and pineapple juice.
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-high. Brown the ham pieces.
Flip the ham and add the pineapple slices around it.
Pour the glaze over everything. Simmer until syrupy, spooning it over.
Serve with rice or roasted potatoes.

recipes.title: Baked cod with buttery crumbs
recipes.blurb: Flaky cod under a crisp golden topping

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Grease a baking dish or line a pan with foil.
Pat the cod dry. Set it in the dish and season with salt and pepper.
Mix the panko, melted butter, Parmesan and garlic powder.
Press the crumbs on top of each fillet.
Bake until the topping is golden and the fish is 145°F and flakes.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan shrimp boil
recipes.blurb: Shrimp, sausage, corn and potatoes with Old Bay

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and half the Old Bay on a large sheet pan.
Roast the potatoes by themselves first.
Add the corn and sausage. Drizzle with 1 tbsp oil and roast.
Toss the shrimp with the last oil and Old Bay. Add to the pan and roast until pink.
Drizzle with the melted butter and squeeze lemon over it all. Serve.

recipes.title: Pan-fried salmon patties
recipes.blurb: Budget-friendly canned salmon cakes with a crisp crust

steps.text: Flake the salmon into a bowl, removing any bones.
Stir in the eggs, panko, mayonnaise, green onions, mustard and pepper.
Shape into 8 patties about 1/2 inch thick. Chill 10 minutes.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium. Fry the patties until golden.
Flip and cook until golden and hot throughout.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Blackened tilapia
recipes.blurb: Smoky spiced fish in 10 minutes

steps.text: Mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, salt and thyme.
Pat the fillets dry and coat both sides with the spice mix.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high until hot.
Cook the fillets until dark and crusty.
Flip and cook until the fish is 145°F and flakes.
Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Brown sugar glazed salmon
recipes.blurb: Sweet-spicy glaze, broiled until caramelized

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Line a sheet pan with foil and lightly oil it.
Whisk the brown sugar, mustard, soy sauce, oil and garlic into a glaze.
Set the salmon on the pan. Season with salt and pepper, then spoon the glaze over each.
Bake until the salmon is 145°F and flakes easily.
For a darker glaze, broil 1 to 2 minutes, watching closely.

recipes.title: Oven fish and chips
recipes.blurb: Crunchy baked cod fillets with seasoned potato wedges

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potato wedges with the oil and 1 tsp salt on a large sheet pan.
Roast the potatoes by themselves first.
Mix the panko, paprika and remaining salt. Coat the cod in flour, then egg, then panko.
Move the potatoes over. Add the cod and spray the tops with cooking spray.
Bake until the cod is 145°F and the crumbs are golden.
Serve with tartar sauce.

recipes.title: Pan-seared crab cakes
recipes.blurb: Mostly crab, lightly bound, with lemon-mayo sauce

steps.text: Gently mix the crab, panko, egg, 2 tbsp mayo, mustard, Old Bay and green onions. Do not break up the lumps.
Form into 8 small cakes. Chill so they hold together.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium. Cook the cakes until golden.
Flip and cook the other side until golden and hot.
Stir the lemon juice into the last 2 tbsp mayo. Serve with the cakes and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken pot pie
recipes.blurb: Creamy chicken and vegetables under a flaky crust

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Melt the butter in a large pot over medium and cook the onion until soft.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute. Slowly add the broth and milk, stirring, until thick.
Stir in the chicken, vegetables, thyme, salt and pepper. Remove from the heat.
Fit one crust in a 9-inch pie plate. Pour in the filling. Cover with the second crust, crimp, and cut 4 slits.
Bake until deep golden and bubbling. Cover the edge with foil if it browns too fast.
Rest 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Tuna noodle casserole
recipes.blurb: Creamy, crunchy-topped comfort from the pantry

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the noodles 2 minutes less than the package says, then drain.
Melt the butter in a large pot. Cook the onion until soft.
Stir in the soup and milk until smooth. Add the tuna, peas and 1 cup cheese.
Fold in the noodles. Pour into a greased 9 by 13 inch dish.
Top with the rest of the cheese and the crushed chips.
Bake until bubbling and golden.

recipes.title: Baked macaroni and cheese
recipes.blurb: Real cheese sauce with a golden crumb top

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the macaroni 2 minutes short of the package time, then drain.
Melt 3 tbsp butter in a pot. Whisk in the flour for 1 minute. Slowly whisk in the milk.
Cook, stirring, until thick enough to coat a spoon. Stir in the mustard, salt and 3 cups cheese.
Fold in the macaroni. Pour into a greased 9 by 13 inch dish and top with the last cheese.
Melt 1 tbsp butter, mix with the panko, and sprinkle over the top.
Bake until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Cheesy chicken broccoli rice casserole
recipes.blurb: Creamy rice bake with chicken and broccoli

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Grease a 9 by 13 inch baking dish.
Whisk the broth, soup, milk, garlic powder and salt. Stir in the rice and 1 cup cheese.
Add the chicken and broccoli and stir. Pour into the dish and cover tightly with foil.
Bake covered until the rice is tender and the chicken is 165°F.
Uncover, top with the rest of the cheese, and bake until melted.
Rest 5 minutes, then fluff and serve.

recipes.title: Shepherd's pie
recipes.blurb: Savory beef and vegetables under mashed potatoes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, then drain.
Mash the potatoes with 3 tbsp butter, the milk and salt.
Brown the beef with the onion and carrots in a large oven-safe skillet. Drain the fat.
Stir in the garlic, tomato paste and broth. Simmer until thickened, then add the peas.
Spread the potatoes over the filling. Dot with the last butter and rake with a fork.
Bake until bubbling and the top is golden.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger casserole
recipes.blurb: Burger flavors baked with pasta and cheddar

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the macaroni 2 minutes short of the package time, then drain.
Brown the beef and onion in a large skillet. Drain the fat.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato sauce, broth, Worcestershire and salt. Simmer.
Mix in the macaroni and 1 cup cheese. Pour into a 9 by 13 inch dish.
Top with the rest of the cheese. Bake until bubbly and the beef is 160°F.

recipes.title: Cheesy ham and potato bake
recipes.blurb: Scalloped potatoes with ham, baked in one dish

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Grease a 9 by 13 inch baking dish.
Melt the butter in a pot. Cook the onion until soft. Whisk in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the milk. Simmer until thickened. Stir in 1 cup cheese, salt and pepper.
Layer the potatoes and ham in the dish. Pour the sauce over.
Cover with foil and bake until the potatoes are almost tender.
Uncover, top with the rest of the cheese, and bake until golden.

recipes.title: Classic beef chili
recipes.blurb: Thick, hearty and mildly spicy, even better the next day

steps.text: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper in a large pot, breaking it up. Drain the fat.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder, cumin and salt for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth. Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat, cover partly, and simmer, stirring now and then.
Taste and add salt. Serve with cheese, sour cream or crackers.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker beef stew
recipes.blurb: Fork-tender beef, potatoes and carrots in a rich gravy

steps.text: Toss the beef with the flour, salt and pepper until coated.
Put the potatoes, carrots, onion and garlic in the slow cooker. Top with the beef.
Whisk the broth, tomato paste and thyme. Pour over the top.
Cover and cook on low until the beef is tender.
Stir in the frozen peas and cook until hot.
Stir and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Broccoli cheddar soup
recipes.blurb: Creamy, cheesy and quick, like the cafe version

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large pot. Cook the onion until soft.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute. Slowly add the milk and broth, stirring.
Add the broccoli and carrot. Simmer, stirring now and then, until tender.
Turn the heat to low. Stir in the cheese a handful at a time until melted.
Season with salt. For a smoother soup, blend part of it with a stick blender.

recipes.title: Loaded baked potato soup
recipes.blurb: Creamy potato soup with bacon, cheddar and green onion

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large pot until crisp. Move it to a plate and leave 2 tbsp fat in the pot.
Cook the onion in the bacon fat until soft. Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Add the broth and potatoes. Simmer until the potatoes are tender.
Mash some of the potatoes right in the pot for a thicker soup.
Stir in the milk, cheese, sour cream and salt. Heat gently without boiling.
Top with bacon and green onions.

recipes.title: Vegetarian three-bean chili
recipes.blurb: Meatless chili with beans, peppers and corn

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pot. Cook the onion and pepper until soft.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, all three beans, corn and broth. Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer, stirring now and then, until thick.
Season with salt and serve with cheese, avocado or tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Classic cheeseburgers
recipes.blurb: Juicy skillet or grill burgers with melty American cheese

steps.text: Divide the beef into 4 loose balls. Flatten each to 3/4 inch, a bit wider than the bun. Press a dimple in the middle.
Season both sides with salt and pepper just before cooking.
Heat a skillet or grill to medium-high. Cook the burgers.
Flip. Cook until 160°F inside. Top with cheese for the last minute.
Toast the buttered buns in the pan until golden.
Build the burgers with lettuce, tomato and your toppings.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
recipes.blurb: Sweet-tangy beef on toasted buns

steps.text: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper in a large skillet, breaking it up. Drain the fat.
Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the ketchup, brown sugar, Worcestershire, mustard and salt.
Simmer on low until thick, stirring now and then.
Toast the buns lightly.
Spoon the beef onto the buns and serve with napkins.

recipes.title: Philly cheesesteak sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Thin beef, peppers and onions with melted provolone

steps.text: Cook the onion and pepper in 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet until soft. Move to a plate.
Add the last oil. Cook the steak over high heat, stirring, until browned. Season with salt and pepper.
Return the vegetables. Pile the mixture into 4 mounds and top each with 2 slices provolone.
Cover until the cheese melts.
Split the rolls and toast lightly. Slide a mound into each roll.

recipes.title: Crispy chicken sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Buttermilk-marinated cutlets, pan-fried and crunchy

steps.text: Soak the cutlets in the buttermilk.
Mix the flour, paprika, salt and pepper in a dish.
Lift out a cutlet, let it drip, and press it into the flour mix on both sides.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high to about 350°F.
Fry the cutlets until deep golden and 165°F inside. Work in batches.
Drain on paper towels. Serve on toasted buns with mayo and pickles.

recipes.title: Classic tuna melts
recipes.blurb: Crisp-toasted bread, warm tuna and gooey cheddar

steps.text: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, celery and mustard in a bowl.
Butter one side of each bread slice. Flip the bread so the butter side is out.
Spread the tuna on 4 slices. Top each with 2 cheese slices and a second slice of bread.
Cook in a skillet over medium-low until golden and the cheese melts.
Flip and toast the other side.
Cut in half and serve.

recipes.title: Black bean burgers
recipes.blurb: Hearty meatless burgers that hold together

ingredients.item: black beans (15 oz), drained and rinsed

steps.text: Mash the beans in a bowl, leaving some chunky. Stir in the panko, egg, rice, cumin, garlic powder and salt.
Shape into 4 patties and chill.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium. Cook the patties until crisp.
Flip carefully and cook until heated through.
Serve on buns with lettuce and your favorite toppings.

recipes.title: Juicy turkey burgers
recipes.blurb: Lean burgers with onion and Worcestershire for flavor

steps.text: Mix the turkey, panko, onion, Worcestershire, garlic powder and salt gently. Form 4 patties and press a dimple in the middle.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium. Cook the patties.
Flip and cook until 165°F inside.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with lettuce and your toppings.

recipes.title: Creamy mashed potatoes
recipes.blurb: Fluffy, buttery and lump-free

steps.text: Put the potatoes in a large pot, cover with cold water, and add the salt.
Bring to a boil, then simmer until a fork slides in easily.
Drain well and return to the hot pot for a minute to steam dry.
Mash with the butter. Pour in the warm milk a little at a time.
Stir in pepper and taste for salt. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Creamy coleslaw
recipes.blurb: Crisp and tangy picnic slaw

steps.text: Whisk the mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the coleslaw mix and toss to coat.
Chill so the flavors blend and the cabbage softens.
Stir, taste, and serve cold.

recipes.title: Classic potato salad
recipes.blurb: Creamy picnic potato salad with egg and pickle

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until just tender. Drain and let cool.
Cover the eggs with water, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat and cover. Let stand, then chill in cold water.
Peel and chop the eggs.
Stir the mayonnaise, mustard, relish, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Fold in the potatoes, eggs, celery and green onions. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Skillet cornbread
recipes.blurb: Golden, tender cornbread with crisp edges

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Put a 10-inch cast-iron skillet in the oven to heat.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the milk, eggs and 4 tbsp butter. Stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Carefully add the last 2 tbsp butter to the hot skillet to coat it. Pour in the batter.
Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 5 minutes, then slice.

recipes.title: Green bean casserole
recipes.blurb: The holiday favorite with crispy onions

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Boil the green beans in salted water until crisp-tender, then drain.
Stir the soup, milk, soy sauce, pepper and 2/3 cup fried onions in a 2-quart baking dish.
Add the green beans and stir to coat.
Bake until bubbling.
Top with the remaining fried onions and bake until golden.

recipes.title: Homestyle baked beans
recipes.blurb: Smoky-sweet beans with bacon, slow-baked

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Cook the bacon in a skillet until crisp.
Add the onion and cook until soft.
Stir the beans, ketchup, brown sugar, mustard, Worcestershire and molasses in a 2-quart baking dish.
Mix in the bacon and onion.
Bake uncovered until thick and bubbly.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Honey glazed carrots
recipes.blurb: Tender, buttery carrots in 15 minutes

steps.text: Put the carrots, butter, honey, water and salt in a large skillet.
Bring to a boil, then cover and cook over medium heat until nearly tender.
Uncover and cook until the liquid becomes a glaze, stirring.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Garlic roasted red potatoes
recipes.blurb: Crispy-edged potatoes with garlic and herbs

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F with a sheet pan inside.
Toss the potatoes with the oil, salt, pepper and rosemary.
Spread them on the hot pan in one layer. Roast, stirring halfway.
Stir in the garlic and roast until golden and crisp.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Creamy macaroni salad
recipes.blurb: Cookout-style pasta salad, made ahead

steps.text: Boil the macaroni until tender, then drain and rinse with cold water.
Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, mustard, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the macaroni, celery, pepper and onion. Stir to coat.
Chill so the pasta soaks up the dressing.
Stir, adding a splash of milk if dry. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Southern buttermilk fried chicken
recipes.blurb: Crunchy, juicy skillet-fried chicken

steps.text: Soak chicken in buttermilk with 1 tsp salt and the pepper in the fridge at least 4 hours.
Whisk flour, 1 tsp salt, paprika and garlic powder in a wide dish.
Lift chicken from the buttermilk, let the extra drip off, then press into the flour to coat well.
Heat 1 inch of oil in a deep skillet to 325°F. Add chicken in batches, skin side down first.
Fry, turning once, until deep golden and 165°F inside, about 12 minutes per side.
Drain on a wire rack and rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Crispy chicken Parmesan with marinara
recipes.blurb: Crispy cutlets under marinara and melted mozzarella

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Pound cutlets to 1/2 inch thick and season with salt.
Set up three dishes: flour, beaten eggs, and panko mixed with half the Parmesan.
Coat each cutlet in flour, egg, then crumbs, pressing to stick.
Pan-fry in olive oil over medium-high heat until golden, about 3 minutes per side.
Move cutlets to a baking sheet. Top with marinara, mozzarella and remaining Parmesan.
Bake until bubbly and chicken reaches 165°F.

recipes.title: Smothered chicken with onion gravy
recipes.blurb: Skillet-browned chicken simmered in rich gravy

steps.text: Mix 1/4 cup flour, paprika, 1 tsp salt and pepper. Coat chicken thighs well.
Brown chicken in hot oil in a large skillet, about 5 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Cook onions in the drippings until soft and golden, about 8 minutes.
Stir in remaining flour for 1 minute, then whisk in broth, thyme and remaining salt.
Return chicken to the gravy, cover and simmer until chicken reaches 175°F and gravy is thick.
Serve over rice or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Grilled BBQ chicken thighs
recipes.blurb: Smoky, sticky thighs fresh off the grill

steps.text: Heat grill to medium and oil the grates. Rub chicken with oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Grill skin side down over indirect heat, lid closed, 15 minutes.
Flip and grill 10 more minutes.
Brush with barbecue sauce and grill 5 minutes, turning once, until 175°F inside.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken cordon bleu
recipes.blurb: Crispy chicken rolled around ham and Swiss

steps.text: Heat oven to 400°F. Butterfly each breast, pound to 1/4 inch and season with salt.
Lay a slice of ham and cheese on each, roll up and secure with toothpicks.
Dredge rolls in flour, beaten egg, then panko.
Brown in olive oil in an ovenproof skillet, 2 minutes per side.
Bake until 165°F inside and crumbs are golden.
Rest 5 minutes and remove toothpicks before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken a la king over biscuits
recipes.blurb: Creamy chicken, peas and mushrooms over warm biscuits

steps.text: Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet. Cook chicken until 165°F inside, about 7 minutes. Remove.
Add remaining butter and mushrooms. Cook until browned, 5 minutes.
Stir in flour for 1 minute. Slowly whisk in broth and milk.
Simmer until thick and creamy.
Stir in chicken, peas and salt and heat through, 2 minutes.
Spoon over split warm biscuits.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan chicken thighs and potatoes
recipes.blurb: Crispy thighs roasted over golden potatoes

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, half the salt and pepper on a large sheet pan.
Rub chicken with remaining oil, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Nestle chicken skin side up among the potatoes.
Roast until chicken reaches 175°F and skin is crisp.
Squeeze lemon over the pan and rest 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Ranch Parmesan baked chicken breasts
recipes.blurb: Crunchy ranch-crumb chicken, easy weeknight bake

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan with foil. Mix panko, Parmesan, garlic powder, salt and oil.
Brush each chicken breast all over with ranch dressing.
Press into the crumb mixture to coat the top and sides.
Bake on the pan until 165°F inside and golden.
Rest 3 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker chicken and gravy
recipes.blurb: Fall-apart chicken in gravy over mashed potatoes

steps.text: Put chicken in the slow cooker. Whisk soup, soup mix, broth and pepper and pour over.
Cook on low until chicken is tender and 165°F or higher.
Shred the chicken in the pot with two forks.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook on high until thickened.
Serve over mashed potatoes or egg noodles.

recipes.title: Pan-fried chicken cutlets with gravy
recipes.blurb: Thin golden cutlets with quick milk gravy

steps.text: Mix flour, salt and pepper on a plate, saving 2 tbsp of the mixture for gravy. Coat cutlets.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Fry cutlets 4 minutes per side until 165°F inside.
Move cutlets to a plate and keep warm. Leave 3 tbsp of drippings in the pan.
Whisk in the saved flour mix and cook 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in milk and simmer until thick, 4 minutes. Season with more pepper.
Pour gravy over the cutlets.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker pulled pork
recipes.blurb: Tender shredded pork shoulder in tangy BBQ sauce

steps.text: Mix brown sugar, paprika, salt, pepper and garlic powder. Rub all over the pork.
Put onion and broth in the slow cooker and set the pork on top.
Cook on low until the pork shreds easily and reaches at least 195°F.
Lift out the pork, discard excess fat and shred with two forks.
Stir in barbecue sauce and a little cooking liquid. Keep warm on low 15 minutes.
Serve on buns or with sides.

recipes.title: Oven BBQ beef brisket
recipes.blurb: Foil-braised brisket, sliced thin with sweet-smoky sauce

steps.text: Heat oven to 300°F. Mix sugar, paprika, salt, pepper and garlic powder and rub on the brisket.
Set brisket fat side up on the onions in a roasting pan. Add broth and cover tightly with foil.
Bake until fork tender, about 4 hours.
Rest 15 minutes, then slice thin against the grain.
Warm barbecue sauce with the pan juices and spoon over the slices.

recipes.title: Skillet smothered pork chops with onions
recipes.blurb: Browned chops simmered in onion gravy

steps.text: Season chops with salt and pepper and dredge in 1/4 cup flour.
Brown in hot oil in a large skillet, 3 minutes per side. Remove.
Cook onion in the pan until soft, 5 minutes. Stir in remaining flour for 1 minute.
Whisk in broth and thyme, scraping up the browned bits.
Return chops to the pan, cover and simmer until pork reaches 145°F.
Rest 3 minutes and serve with gravy.

recipes.title: Roast pork loin with pan gravy
recipes.blurb: Juicy sliced pork loin with garlic and herbs

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F. Mix oil, garlic, rosemary, salt and pepper and rub all over the roast.
Roast in a pan until the center reaches 145°F, about 1 hour 10 minutes.
Move to a board, tent with foil and rest 15 minutes.
Whisk flour into the pan drippings over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add broth and simmer until thickened, 5 minutes.
Slice the pork and serve with the gravy.

recipes.title: Oven BBQ country-style pork ribs
recipes.blurb: Meaty ribs baked tender and glazed

steps.text: Heat oven to 325°F. Season ribs with salt, pepper, garlic powder and paprika.
Place in a baking dish with the water and cover tightly with foil.
Bake until tender, about 2 hours.
Raise oven to 425°F. Drain most of the liquid and coat ribs with barbecue sauce.
Bake uncovered until sauce is sticky, 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Brown sugar glazed baked ham
recipes.blurb: Holiday-style ham with a sweet mustard glaze

steps.text: Heat oven to 325°F. Set the ham cut side down in a roasting pan with a little water. Cover with foil.
Bake about 15 minutes per pound, until the center is 120°F.
Warm sugar, mustard, honey, juice and cloves in a small pot until smooth.
Brush glaze over the ham. Bake uncovered, glazing again halfway, until 140°F.
Rest 15 minutes, then carve.

recipes.title: Smoked sausage and potato skillet
recipes.blurb: Browned kielbasa, crispy potatoes and peppers in one pan

steps.text: Microwave or boil the potato pieces until just tender, 5 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet. Brown the potatoes until crispy, 8 minutes.
Add sausage, pepper and onion. Cook until browned and soft, 7 minutes.
Season with paprika and salt and toss. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Classic stuffed bell peppers
recipes.blurb: Beef and rice stuffed peppers baked in tomato sauce

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F. Stand peppers upright in a baking dish.
Brown beef with onion until cooked through, 8 minutes. Drain fat.
Stir in rice, half the tomato sauce, salt and pepper.
Fill peppers and pour the remaining sauce around them. Cover with foil.
Bake 40 minutes, then top with cheese and bake until melted. Filling should be 160°F.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker beef and noodles
recipes.blurb: Tender beef in gravy over buttery egg noodles

steps.text: Put beef in the slow cooker. Stir together soup mix, mushroom soup, broth and pepper and pour over.
Cook on low until the beef is fork tender.
Shred the beef lightly and stir it into the gravy.
Boil noodles in salted water per package directions and drain.
Toss noodles with butter and serve topped with the beef and gravy.

recipes.title: Baked pork chops with stuffing
recipes.blurb: Chops baked under a golden herb stuffing crust

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13 dish. Season chops with salt and pepper.
Mix stuffing mix, 1 cup broth and melted butter just until moist.
Whisk soup with remaining broth and pour into the dish. Lay chops on top.
Mound stuffing over each chop and cover with foil.
Bake 25 minutes, uncover and bake until pork reaches 145°F and the top is crisp.

recipes.title: Skillet ribeye with garlic herb butter
recipes.blurb: Deep-crusted steakhouse ribeye in a cast iron pan

steps.text: Pat steaks dry and let them sit at room temperature 30 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat a cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking. Add the oil.
Sear steaks 3 minutes without moving, flip and sear 2 minutes.
Add butter, garlic and thyme. Tilt the pan and baste for 1 to 2 minutes until 135°F for medium rare.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Grilled sirloin with herb butter
recipes.blurb: Thick sirloin steaks with a melting parsley butter

steps.text: Mash butter with parsley and garlic. Roll into a log and chill.
Heat grill to high. Rub steaks with oil, salt and pepper.
Grill 4 to 5 minutes per side to 135°F for medium rare, or 145°F for medium.
Rest 5 minutes with a slice of herb butter on each.

recipes.title: New York strip with peppercorn pan sauce
recipes.blurb: Seared strip steak with a creamy peppercorn sauce

steps.text: Pat steaks dry, season with salt and press cracked pepper onto both sides.
Sear in hot oil in a skillet, 4 minutes per side for medium rare, 135°F. Move to a plate.
Cook shallot in the pan 1 minute. Add broth and scrape up the browned bits.
Stir in cream and simmer until slightly thick, 3 minutes.
Rest steaks 5 minutes, then serve with the sauce.

recipes.title: Grilled marinated flank steak
recipes.blurb: Garlicky Worcestershire marinade, sliced thin

steps.text: Whisk oil, Worcestershire, vinegar, garlic, pepper and salt. Add steak in a zip bag and marinate 2 hours or overnight.
Heat grill to high. Remove steak and pat dry.
Grill 5 to 6 minutes per side for medium rare, 135°F.
Rest 10 minutes, then slice thin against the grain.

recipes.title: Grilled tri-tip with garlic rub
recipes.blurb: Juicy California-style roast, sliced against the grain

steps.text: Mix oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper and rub all over the tri-tip. Rest 30 minutes.
Set grill for two-zone heat at medium-high. Sear the roast 4 minutes per side over direct heat.
Move to indirect heat, cover and cook until 130°F for medium rare, about 20 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes, then slice thin against the grain.

recipes.title: Pan-seared filet mignon with mushrooms
recipes.blurb: Tender filets with butter-browned mushrooms

steps.text: Heat oven to 400°F. Season steaks and sear in hot oil in an ovenproof skillet, 2 minutes per side.
Roast in the oven to 130°F for medium rare, 5 to 7 minutes.
Rest steaks on a plate 5 minutes.
Melt butter in the skillet. Cook mushrooms until browned, 6 minutes, adding garlic at the end.
Serve steaks topped with the mushrooms.

recipes.title: Skillet steak with caramelized onions
recipes.blurb: Pan-seared sirloin topped with sweet onions

steps.text: Cook onions in butter in a skillet over medium-low until deep golden, 20 minutes. Stir in Worcestershire.
Season steak with salt and pepper. Heat oil in another skillet over high heat.
Sear steak 4 to 5 minutes per side to 135°F for medium rare.
Rest 5 minutes, slice against the grain and top with onions.

recipes.title: Grilled steak and potato foil packs
recipes.blurb: Sirloin tips, potatoes and onion steamed in foil

steps.text: Heat grill to medium-high. Toss steak, potatoes and onion with oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Divide onto four large sheets of heavy foil. Top each with butter and seal tightly.
Grill packs, covered, 30 to 35 minutes, turning once, until potatoes are tender and beef is 145°F.
Open carefully and watch for steam.

recipes.title: Country chicken-fried steak and gravy
recipes.blurb: Crispy breaded cube steak with peppery white gravy

steps.text: Mix flour, salt and 1 tsp pepper in a dish. Whisk eggs with 1/2 cup milk in another.
Dredge steaks in flour, dip in egg, then flour again, pressing well.
Fry in 350°F oil, 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and 160°F inside. Drain on a rack.
Pour off all but 1/4 cup drippings. Whisk in 1/4 cup of the leftover flour and cook 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in 2 cups milk. Simmer until thick and season with remaining pepper.
Spoon gravy over the steaks.

recipes.title: Dutch oven pot roast
recipes.blurb: Oven-braised chuck roast with carrots and potatoes

steps.text: Heat oven to 325°F. Season roast with salt and pepper and sear in hot oil in a Dutch oven, 4 minutes per side.
Add onion, broth and tomato paste, then cover and bake 2 hours.
Add potatoes and carrots around the roast. Cover and bake until everything is fork tender.
Rest 10 minutes, then shred or slice. Spoon the juices over the top.

recipes.title: Swiss steak in tomato gravy
recipes.blurb: Round steak braised until fork tender in tomatoes and onions

steps.text: Pound steak pieces to 1/2 inch. Coat in flour mixed with salt and pepper.
Brown in hot oil in a Dutch oven, 3 minutes per side. Remove.
Cook onion in the pot 3 minutes. Add tomatoes and broth and scrape up the browned bits.
Return steak, cover and simmer on low until very tender.
Serve with mashed potatoes or noodles.

recipes.title: Hamburger steak with onion gravy
recipes.blurb: Seared beef patties smothered in onion gravy

steps.text: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, 1 tsp salt and pepper. Shape into 4 oval patties.
Sear in hot oil in a skillet, 4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Cook onions in the drippings until golden, 8 minutes. Stir in flour for 1 minute.
Whisk in broth and remaining salt and simmer until thick.
Return patties to the gravy and simmer until 160°F inside, about 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage gravy over buttermilk biscuits
recipes.blurb: Peppery pork sausage gravy over split buttermilk biscuits

steps.text: Brown the sausage in a large skillet, breaking it up, until cooked through to 160°F, 8 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over the sausage and stir for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the milk, stirring constantly.
Simmer until thick, 6 to 8 minutes. Add pepper and salt.
Spoon over warm split biscuits.

recipes.title: Turkey meatloaf with ketchup glaze
recipes.blurb: Moist lean meatloaf with a sweet tangy top

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F. Soak breadcrumbs in milk for 5 minutes.
Mix turkey, soaked crumbs, onion, eggs, salt, pepper and 1/4 cup ketchup.
Pack into a loaf pan or shape a loaf on a lined sheet pan.
Stir remaining ketchup with the brown sugar and spread on top.
Bake until 165°F in the center.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Classic beef stroganoff
recipes.blurb: Seared beef and mushrooms in sour cream sauce over noodles

steps.text: Boil noodles in salted water until tender and drain.
Season beef and sear in 1 tbsp butter in a hot skillet, 2 minutes. Remove.
Cook mushrooms and onion in the remaining butter until soft, 7 minutes.
Stir in flour, then broth. Simmer until thick, 4 minutes.
Off heat, stir in sour cream and the beef. Serve over noodles.

recipes.title: American goulash
recipes.blurb: Macaroni, beef and tomatoes in one pot

steps.text: Brown beef with onion and pepper in a Dutch oven until cooked through, 8 minutes. Drain fat.
Add garlic, tomatoes, sauce, broth and Italian seasoning and bring to a simmer.
Stir in macaroni, cover and simmer until tender, stirring now and then.
Season with salt and black pepper. Top with cheddar and serve.

recipes.title: Roast turkey breast with gravy
recipes.blurb: Easy herb-butter turkey breast for any Sunday

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F. Mix butter, sage, thyme, salt and pepper. Rub it over and under the skin.
Roast on a rack with 1 cup broth in the pan until 165°F at the thickest part, about 1.5 hours.
Rest 20 minutes, loosely covered.
Whisk flour into the pan drippings, then add remaining broth. Simmer until thick.
Slice and serve with gravy.

recipes.title: Country-fried pork chops
recipes.blurb: Crispy pan-fried chops, Southern kitchen style

steps.text: Soak chops in buttermilk for 30 minutes.
Mix flour, salt, pepper and paprika. Coat chops, pressing the flour on.
Heat 1/2 inch of oil in a heavy skillet to 350°F.
Fry 5 to 6 minutes per side until golden and 145°F inside.
Drain on a rack and rest 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Tater tot casserole
recipes.blurb: Beef, green beans and cheese under crispy tots

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F. Brown beef and onion until cooked through, 8 minutes. Drain.
Stir in soup, green beans and salt. Spread in a 9x13 dish.
Top with half the cheese, then arrange tots in rows.
Bake until bubbly and tots are golden and beef reaches 160°F, about 35 minutes.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake 5 minutes more.

recipes.title: Homestyle beef and sausage lasagna
recipes.blurb: Layers of meat sauce, ricotta and mozzarella

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F. Brown beef and sausage, drain, then simmer with marinara and tomatoes, 15 minutes.
Boil noodles 2 minutes less than the package says, then drain.
Mix ricotta, egg and Parmesan.
Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta and mozzarella in a 9x13 dish, three layers, ending with sauce and cheese.
Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes, then uncover and bake until browned and 165°F in the center.
Rest 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Cheesy baked spaghetti
recipes.blurb: Spaghetti and meat sauce baked under bubbling cheese

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F. Boil spaghetti until al dente and drain.
Brown beef and onion, drain, and stir in marinara.
Toss spaghetti with sour cream and half the mozzarella.
Spread half in a 9x13 dish, top with half the sauce, then repeat.
Cover with remaining cheeses. Bake until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Chicken divan
recipes.blurb: Broccoli and chicken in a creamy cheddar sauce

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F. Steam broccoli 3 minutes and spread in a baking dish.
Top with the chicken.
Stir soup, mayo, curry powder and half the cheddar, and pour over.
Toss panko with melted butter and remaining cheese and sprinkle on top.
Bake until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Sausage and hash brown egg bake
recipes.blurb: Eggs, sausage, hash browns and cheddar in one dish

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 dish. Brown sausage until cooked through and drain.
Spread hash browns in the dish and top with sausage and 1.5 cups cheese.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt and pepper and pour over.
Bake until set in the center and eggs reach 160°F, about 50 minutes.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and rest 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken and stuffing bake
recipes.blurb: Easy Thanksgiving-flavored chicken dinner in one dish

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13 dish.
Mix chicken, soup, vegetables and 1/2 cup broth. Spread in the dish.
Stir stuffing mix with remaining broth and the butter. Spoon on top.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes.
Uncover and bake until the top is crisp and chicken reaches 165°F.

recipes.title: Cheesy chicken spaghetti
recipes.blurb: Creamy, cheesy chicken pasta bake

ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green chiles (10 oz)

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F. Boil spaghetti 2 minutes short of done and drain.
Cook onion and pepper in a little oil until soft, 5 minutes.
Stir in soup, tomatoes, broth, chicken and half the cheese.
Toss with the spaghetti and pour into a 9x13 dish. Top with remaining cheese.
Bake until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Beef and cheese stuffed shells
recipes.blurb: Jumbo shells filled with ricotta and baked in sauce

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F. Boil shells 2 minutes short of done and drain.
Brown the beef until cooked through and drain.
Mix beef with ricotta, egg, Parmesan and 1 cup mozzarella.
Spread half the marinara in a 9x13 dish. Fill shells and set them in the sauce.
Top with remaining sauce and mozzarella. Cover and bake 25 minutes, then uncover 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Scalloped potatoes with kielbasa
recipes.blurb: Creamy sliced potatoes baked with smoked sausage

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13 dish. Layer potatoes and kielbasa in it.
Melt butter, whisk in flour for 1 minute, then add milk, salt and pepper. Simmer until thick, 4 minutes.
Stir in 1 cup cheese until melted and pour over the potatoes.
Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes.
Uncover, top with remaining cheese and bake until potatoes are tender and golden.

recipes.title: Bacon cheeseburgers
recipes.blurb: Thick beef patties with crispy bacon and melted cheddar

steps.text: Cook bacon until crisp, about 10 minutes, and drain on paper towels.
Shape beef into 4 patties slightly wider than the buns. Season with salt and pepper and press a dimple in each.
Cook on a hot grill or skillet 4 to 5 minutes per side until 160°F inside.
Add cheese for the last minute and toast the buns.
Build with bacon, lettuce and tomato.

recipes.title: Patty melts
recipes.blurb: Diner burgers on griddled rye with Swiss and onions

steps.text: Cook onions in 1 tbsp butter over medium-low until golden and sweet, 15 minutes.
Shape beef into 4 oval patties and season. Cook in a skillet 4 minutes per side to 160°F.
Butter one side of each bread slice. Layer a slice of cheese, a patty, onions and more cheese on unbuttered sides.
Top with bread, buttered side out. Griddle 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.

recipes.title: Grilled Reuben sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Corned beef, Swiss, sauerkraut and Russian dressing on rye

steps.text: Spread dressing on one side of each bread slice.
Layer cheese, corned beef, sauerkraut and more cheese on four slices. Top with remaining bread.
Butter the outsides of the sandwiches.
Griddle in a skillet over medium heat 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.

recipes.title: French dip sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Roast beef rolls with hot beef au jus for dipping

steps.text: Simmer broth, Worcestershire and garlic powder in a skillet 5 minutes.
Add the beef and warm it in the jus 3 minutes.
Heat oven to 400°F. Fill rolls with beef and cheese and toast on a pan until the cheese melts, 5 minutes.
Serve with cups of hot jus for dipping.

recipes.title: Open-faced hot turkey sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Sliced turkey on toast under hot gravy

steps.text: Melt butter in a saucepan and whisk in flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in broth and pepper and simmer until thick, 5 minutes.
Add the turkey and warm it in the gravy 3 minutes.
Pile turkey on toast and pour gravy over. Serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: BBQ pulled chicken sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Slow-cooked shredded chicken piled on soft buns

steps.text: Put chicken in the slow cooker. Mix barbecue sauce, broth, sugar and vinegar and pour over.
Cook on low until chicken is tender, 165°F or higher.
Shred the chicken with two forks and stir it in the sauce. Cook 10 more minutes.
Serve on toasted buns with coleslaw mix.

recipes.title: Chili dogs
recipes.blurb: Grilled hot dogs loaded with homemade beef chili and cheese

steps.text: Brown beef and onion until cooked through, 8 minutes. Drain.
Stir in tomato sauce, chili powder, salt and 1/2 cup water. Simmer until thick, 15 minutes.
Grill or pan-cook hot dogs until browned and hot, about 6 minutes.
Nestle hot dogs in buns, spoon chili on top and add cheddar.

recipes.title: Turkey club sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Triple-decker turkey, bacon, lettuce and tomato

steps.text: Cook bacon until crisp and drain.
Spread mayo on all the toast.
Stack toast, turkey and lettuce, toast, bacon and tomato, then toast.
Cut each triple-decker into quarters and secure with toothpicks.

recipes.title: Sausage and pepper hoagies
recipes.blurb: Grilled Italian sausage with sweet peppers and onions

steps.text: Cook sausages in a skillet over medium heat, turning, until 160°F inside, about 18 minutes.
Remove sausages. Add oil, peppers, onion and oregano and cook until soft, 8 minutes.
Tuck sausages into rolls, top with peppers and cheese.
Broil 1 to 2 minutes until the cheese melts.

recipes.title: Cheesy shrimp and grits with bacon
recipes.blurb: Creamy cheddar grits topped with garlicky bacon shrimp

steps.text: Bring water and 1 tsp salt to a boil. Whisk in grits, then simmer, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Meanwhile, cook bacon in a skillet until crisp, 8 minutes. Remove, leaving 1 tbsp fat.
Cook shrimp in the bacon fat 2 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Add garlic for the last 30 seconds.
Stir butter and cheddar into the grits.
Top with shrimp, bacon and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: New England baked haddock
recipes.blurb: Haddock baked in butter under buttery cracker crumbs

steps.text: Heat oven to 400°F. Lay fish in a baking dish and sprinkle with salt.
Melt butter with the juice of half the lemon and toss with cracker crumbs and paprika.
Pile the crumbs over the fish.
Bake until the fish flakes and reaches 145°F.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Grilled garlic butter shrimp skewers
recipes.blurb: Smoky grilled shrimp brushed with lemon garlic butter

steps.text: Soak 8 wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes, if using wood.
Mix butter, garlic, lemon juice, paprika and salt. Toss half with the shrimp and thread onto skewers.
Grill over medium-high heat 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Brush with the remaining butter and sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Baked lemon-dill salmon
recipes.blurb: Foil-baked salmon fillets with butter and fresh dill

steps.text: Heat oven to 400°F. Place salmon on a lined pan and brush with butter.
Season with salt and pepper and top with dill and lemon slices.
Bake until the fish flakes easily and reaches 145°F, 12 to 15 minutes.
Serve with the remaining lemon.

recipes.title: Hearty beef barley soup
recipes.blurb: Tender beef, barley and vegetables in a rich broth

steps.text: Brown beef in oil in a Dutch oven in two batches, 5 minutes each. Remove.
Cook onion, carrots and celery in the pot 5 minutes.
Add broth, beef, thyme and salt. Simmer covered 1 hour.
Stir in barley and simmer until barley and beef are tender, 30 minutes.
Season with black pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Smoky ham hock and navy bean soup
recipes.blurb: Smoky ham hock and navy beans, simmered slow

steps.text: Cover beans with water by 2 inches and soak overnight, then drain.
Combine beans, ham hock, vegetables, 8 cups water and pepper in a Dutch oven. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer until beans are tender, about 2 hours.
Remove the hock, shred the meat and stir it back in. Season with salt.

recipes.title: New England clam chowder
recipes.blurb: Creamy potato chowder with bacon and tender clams

steps.text: Cook bacon in a Dutch oven until crisp, 6 minutes. Remove and keep the fat.
Cook onion in the fat 4 minutes. Stir in flour for 1 minute.
Add clam juice, canned clam liquid and potatoes. Simmer until potatoes are tender, 15 minutes.
Stir in milk, cream, clams and pepper. Heat gently, do not boil, 5 minutes.
Serve topped with the bacon.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger soup
recipes.blurb: All the flavors of a cheeseburger in a creamy bowl

steps.text: Brown beef and onion until cooked through and drain.
Add broth and potatoes. Simmer until potatoes are tender, 15 minutes.
Whisk flour into milk and stir into the pot. Simmer until thickened, 5 minutes.
Stir in cheddar, ketchup and salt until melted. Serve with pickles and croutons.

recipes.title: Flaky buttermilk biscuits
recipes.blurb: Tall, flaky biscuits with golden tops

steps.text: Heat oven to 450°F. Whisk flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
Cut in cold butter with your fingers until pea-sized crumbs form.
Stir in buttermilk just until a shaggy dough forms.
Pat to 1 inch thick, cut 8 rounds and place close together on a pan.
Bake until tall and golden.

recipes.title: Creamy scalloped potatoes
recipes.blurb: Thin-sliced potatoes baked in garlic cream sauce

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13 dish.
Melt butter, cook garlic 30 seconds, whisk in flour, then milk, salt and pepper. Simmer until thick.
Layer potatoes in the dish, pouring sauce and a sprinkle of cheese over each layer.
Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes.
Uncover and bake until tender and golden, 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Wedge salad with bacon and blue cheese
recipes.blurb: Steakhouse iceberg wedges with creamy dressing

steps.text: Cook bacon until crisp, about 10 minutes, then crumble.
Set a lettuce wedge on each plate.
Spoon dressing over the wedges.
Top with bacon, tomatoes, blue cheese and pepper.
